description: Lets CerebrOS send an event organizer's ticket and guest email from their own domain (through Resend), with SPF and DKIM on a send. subdomain. The website and existing mailboxes on the domain are not changed.
variableDescription: %region%: the Amazon SES region Resend assigned to the domain, such as us-east-1; %dkim%: the DKIM public key Resend issued for the domain (the part after p=).
